# Infinite Red — account brief

## Who

Infinite Red is a consultancy specializing in React Native app design and development ([source](https://infinitered.com/)). Its GitHub org profile links to infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `infinitered/ignite` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` in `infinitered/ignite` pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 150 public repos and 2,100 followers ([source](https://github.com/infinitered)).
- `infinitered/ignite` last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)).
- Infinite Red links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://infinitered.com/careers)). The evidence does not say what roles, if any, are open.

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@infinitered-maintainer-1) — top contributor to `infinitered/ignite` with 310 commits ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Infinite Red" and website https://infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)). No title, location, or bio in the evidence.
- Maintainer Two (@infinitered-maintainer-2) — 188 commits to `infinitered/ignite` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Infinite Red" and website https://infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2)). No title, location, or bio in the evidence.
- Maintainer Three (@infinitered-maintainer-3) — 97 commits to `infinitered/ignite` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Infinite Red" and website https://infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-3)). No title, location, or bio in the evidence.

## Why now

`infinitered/ignite` last pushed on 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)), and it is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)). The evidence contains no store listing, so release cadence is unknown.

## Suggested opener

Addressed to Maintainer One (@infinitered-maintainer-1), top contributor to `infinitered/ignite` with 310 commits and an Infinite Red company listing on their profile ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)).

> You've put 310 commits into ignite ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)), and it ships with an eas.json ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside GitHub Actions workflows ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/tree/main/.github/workflows)) on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)). When a team starts from that template, what does the split end up being between your workflows and EAS Build for credentials and store submission?
